messages:
Maya (People Ops): Thanks everyone — follow-ups from the all-hands on workstyle, travel, and offsites. Drop questions here and we'll answer live. :wave:
Priya (People Ops): Quick recap — hub days stay at 1x / week by default, teams can opt for 2x with manager sign-off. Offsite windows will be published monthly.
Alex (Eng): For team offsites, what's the approval flow? budget cap per person?
Maya (People Ops): Good Q. Approval flow is: manager -> People Ops (logistics) -> Finance for >$5k total. Budget cap guideline: $1,200 / person standard; exceptions require manager + finance ok.
Rahul (Eng Manager): Are there special rules for international travel (visa letters, longer notice)?
Priya (People Ops): Yes — submit travel requests at least 6 weeks out for international. We provide official invitation/visa letters on request; People Ops will coordinate with Finance for reimbursable expenses.
Eve (Finance): Reimbursements: keep receipts, submit via Expensely within 30 days. Childcare add-on is eligible up to $300/day with prior approval.
Sofia (People Ops Intern): What about coworking hub passes for folks in APAC?
Maya (People Ops): We're piloting a flexible stipend in APAC: you can claim coworking passes up to $150/month. We'll roll out via the benefits portal next week.
Alex (Eng): Hub desk booking — still first-come-first-served? Can teams reserve a row for sprint weeks?
Priya (People Ops): Desk booking remains FCFS for hotdesking. Teams can request a row for dedicated weeks; send a request with dates and expected headcount. We'll try to honor within reason.
Julian (CEO): Heads-up: exec team supports more predictable team weeks in-person for cross-team work. Not mandatory — aim for clear calendar expectations.
Rahul (Eng Manager): If we need to change travel due to model dev timelines, what's the cancellation policy?
Maya (People Ops): We encourage booking refundable fares where possible. For reserved offsites, we'll keep a small contingency fund; case-by-case. If canceled <14 days before event, cost may be prorated to team budget.
Priya (People Ops): Action: we'll publish an updated "Offsite & Travel FAQ" doc with templates (visa letter request, travel request form) and a choreography checklist (book flights, visas, accommodations). ETA: Friday.
Alex (Eng): Can People Ops share the template for team-level risk/backup plan?
Sofia (People Ops Intern): Yes — will add the risk/backup template (1-page) to the FAQ.
Maya (People Ops): Note on parental accommodations: contact People Ops early; we have flexible reimbursement and alternative scheduling options.
Julian (CEO): Also exploring a small travel concierge pilot for exec-scheduled cross-region rotation. More details in next product sync.
Priya (People Ops): For folks on Dedicated or Private deployments who travel to partner sites, check security clearance checklist in eng-security channel and fill the remote-access form.
Rahul (Eng Manager): Are there any tax/immigration flags for short-term cross-border work?
Eve (Finance): If someone works >30 days in a country, tax/immigration may apply. People Ops + Finance will flag based on dates in the request form.
Alex (Eng): Thanks — this is helpful. Will wait for FAQ.
Maya (People Ops): TL;DR action items: 1) People Ops publishes FAQ + templates by Friday, 2) Add APAC coworking stipend rollout note, 3) Share desk-row request flow, 4) Clarify cancellation cost policy. Ping @Priya for urgent cases. :thumbsup:
allhands-bot: All-hands follow-up thread closed for edits after 60m (bot note).
